published_prior_art.cite: DwivediTianTomkinsKlasnjaMurphyShah2025: adaptive nearest-neighbor unit-by-time counterfactual inference under exogenous nonlinear factors.

CaiLiChiPoorChen2021Subspace: independent-entry diagonal-deleted-Gram rowwise subspace theory; DwivediTianTomkinsKlasnjaMurphyShah2025: adaptive counterfactual imputation with a different target and estimator; AtheyBayatiDoudchenkoImbensKhosravi2021 and SunZhuDubin2025 are omitted adjacent causal/longitudinal low-rank matrix-completion comparators.
CaiLiChiPoorChen2021Subspace: independent-Gaussian incomplete-matrix lower bound, not a bounded sequential causal-score experiment.
KhanUgander2023AdaptiveNormalization: scalar affine IPW normalization under i.i.d. indicators, not a row-subspace drift certificate.
BelloniOliveira2018MartingaleCLT supplies high-dimensional martingale multiplier approximation; XiaYuan2021LinearForms supplies low-rank matrix-form inference under i.i.d. sampling.

novelty_flags.label: related_work; thm:ipw-rowwise-upper; thm:adaptive-minimax-lower
novelty_flags.one_line: The survey omits Athey et al. (JASA 2021) on causal panel matrix completion with time-dependent missingness and Sun, Zhu, and Dubin (Can. J. Stat. 2025) on longitudinal low-rank IPW matrix completion with serial correlation; both are closer than several listed informed-by comparators.

source_verification_receipts.version: Canadian Journal of Statistics 53(3) (2025), e70002, published article
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article studies longitudinal low-rank matrix completion, uses IPW for MAR missingness, permits serial correlation, and gives non-asymptotic estimation-error results; it is adjacent rather than identical because it does not establish the proposed predictable-treatment IPW-SVD row-subspace frontier.

source_verification_receipts.locator: Abstract and Section 1, pp. 58–61; online lines 63–75 and 101–115
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper develops double-sample-debiased, low-rank-projection inference for linear forms in noisy matrix completion with i.i.d. trace-regression observations.

source_verification_receipts.version: Electronic Communications in Probability 16 (2011), published PDF
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Matrix Freedman controls self-adjoint and rectangular matrix martingales through bounded increments and predictable quadratic variation.
The paper establishes high-dimensional martingale Gaussian couplings and multiplier-bootstrap approximation for maxima.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add Athey, Bayati, Doudchenko, Imbens, and Khosravi (JASA 2021) and Sun, Zhu, and Dubin (Canadian Journal of Statistics 2025), then state precisely why their panel/MAR weighted-completion targets and guarantees neither imply nor are implied by the predictable-treatment IPW-SVD row-subspace theorem.

Make the upper/lower pair's novelty auditable by adding a compact comparison table that contrasts the sampling law, estimand, estimator, loss, and lower-bound experiment against Cai et al., Dwivedi et al., Athey et al., and Sun et al.
Strengthen the blind branch with an implementable correction or upper certificate for the denominator tangent, rather than only a diagnostic for when the uncorrected blind fit fails.

recommended_next_step: Revise the literature map and theorem gaps around the two omitted longitudinal/causal matrix-completion comparators, then resubmit this otherwise field-grade rate-and-diagnostic kernel for review.
